issues.description: The Lights Out puzzle uses the same conceptual quantum register but different identifiers across artifacts: the problem statement refers to the register as the "flip" register (e.g. "query (flip and tile) registers"), the template stub for state_preparation names the parameter switch_register, while the reference solution uses flip_register. Because the function parameter in the template (switch_register) is the student-facing entry point to implement state preparation, this mismatch forces students to mentally map "switch_register" -> "flip register" and may cause confusion when reading docstrings, tests, and the solution. Exact identifiers: problem statement: "flip" register; template state_preparation parameter: switch_register; solution state_preparation parameter: flip_register.
issues.suggestedFix: Rename the template function parameter and any internal uses from 'switch_register' to 'flip_register' (and update related docstrings/comments in template_repository/ex4_grover_lights_out_puzzle.py) so the template parameter name matches the problem statement and the reference solution. This keeps the conceptual entity name consistent across problem_statement.md, the template stub, and the solution while preserving the exercise intent.
